payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear comparison of the performance of CGExpan and LM-Base, indicating that LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text due to the challenges posed by such text.

claims.text: LM-Base significantly outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text benchmarks, while CGExpan performs better on well-curated benchmarks.
The performance drop of CGExpan is larger on user-generated text compared to simpler methods like LM-Base, indicating that CGExpan struggles with the characteristics of user-generated text.
CGExpan's methodology includes more complex mechanisms than LM-Base, which may contribute to its underperformance on user-generated text.
